summary: Extra vars passed with -e always have the highest precedence, overriding defaults and play vars; network operators use this, including via AWX or Platform job template surveys.
questions: Which variables have the highest precedence in Ansible?
How do I override a variable for one run?
How can non-technical users supply variables to a playbook?

answer_card.title: Highest precedence: extra vars
answer_card.answer_md:
`-e` / `--extra-vars` always win:
```bash
ansible-playbook playbook.yml -e "dns=192.168.1.1" -l rtr3
```
This overrides both role defaults and play vars. AWX/Automation Platform job template **surveys** use this to collect values from operators through a web form.
